description: Use either `//` or `/* */` comment syntax consistently within a file. `//` is much more common.

semgrep.limitations: Requires custom rule to detect mixed comment styles across a file

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C analysis

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to check comment style consistency

description: Use default capture by value (`[=]`) sparingly. It should only be used to bind a few variables for a short lambda and must not capture `this` implicitly. Prefer explicit captures.

semgrep.limitations: Can detect the pattern but cannot reliably assess lambda length or implicit `this` capture without deeper analysis.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires complex custom query to evaluate lambda length and implicit capture context.

description: Detect use of 'static' for internal linkage in .cc files. Prefer unnamed namespaces.

semgrep.limitations: cannot enforce preference for unnamed namespace

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to detect .cc files and static linkage

description: Type conversion operators and constructors callable with a single argument must be marked explicit. Copy/move constructors are exception.

semgrep.limitations: requires type resolution to distinguish copy/move constructors

codeql.limitations: requires full type analysis for copy/move detection

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis

description: Local variables should be declared in the narrowest scope possible, as close to first use as possible, and initialized in the declaration.

semgrep.limitations: May have false positives with complex control flow or variable reassignments.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to detect declaration far from first use.

description: TODO comments must be in all caps, followed by a bug ID, name, email, or identifier, and include a specific date or event.

semgrep.limitations: requires custom regex for full format validation

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for comment text pattern matching

description: Detect use of non-inclusive or offensive terms (e.g., 'master', 'slave', 'blacklist', 'whitelist') in identifiers and string literals.

semgrep.limitations: regex pattern may match in comments or documentation strings; requires custom pattern list for comprehensive coverage

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to match specific terms in identifiers and strings

description: A class's public API must make clear whether it is copyable, move-only, or neither by explicitly declaring or deleting copy/move constructors and assignment operators.

semgrep.limitations: requires complex pattern matching for all special member functions and their access specifiers

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to check for missing explicit declarations

description: Use C++-style casts (static_cast, const_cast, reinterpret_cast, std::bit_cast). Do not use C-style casts except to void. Brace initialization is allowed for arithmetic conversions.

semgrep.limitations: May match false positives in macro expansions or complex type expressions.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to exclude casts to void and brace initialization.

description: Use unnamed namespaces for definitions that do not need to be referenced outside the .cc file. Do not use in .h files.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis

description: Two continuation lines must use the same indentation level if they begin with syntactically parallel elements, such as arguments on separate lines aligning.

semgrep.limitations: requires custom logic for indentation and syntactic parallelism detection

pmd.limitations: PMD does not have a built-in rule for parallel continuation indentation; requires custom rule

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for indentation and syntactic structure

description: Non-ASCII characters should use the actual Unicode character or equivalent Unicode escape for readability. Unicode escapes outside string literals and comments are strongly discouraged.

semgrep.limitations: requires pattern to match Unicode escapes outside strings/comments; may have false positives in complex nested structures

pmd.limitations: requires custom rule to detect Unicode escapes outside string literals and comments

codeql.limitations: requires query to locate Unicode escape sequences and check their syntactic context

description: Switch label colon must be followed by a line break, and statements within the case group must be indented further by +2 spaces.

semgrep.limitations: pattern matches basic case but may not validate all indentation levels or multi-statement blocks

pmd.limitations: requires custom rule for indentation check

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for formatting rule

description: Identifiers must use only ASCII letters, digits, and underscores, matching the regex \w+.

semgrep.limitations: regex matching may not capture all identifier contexts (e.g., within f-strings)

pmd.limitations: PMD does not have a built-in rule for this specific identifier character check; requires custom rule

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to check identifier naming pattern

description: TODO comments must begin with TODO in all caps, followed by a colon, a link to a resource (preferably a bug reference), a hyphen, and an explanatory string.

semgrep.limitations: regex validation on metavariables may be limited

pmd.limitations: PMD does not have a built-in rule for TODO comment format; requires custom rule

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for comment format

description: Prefer to break lines at a higher syntactic level (e.g., after '(') rather than inside a lower-level construct like a method name.

semgrep.limitations: Semgrep patterns are not well-suited for detecting preferred line break positions in formatting rules.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not have a built-in rule for line-wrapping at higher syntactic levels; requires custom formatting rule.

codeql.limitations: CodeQL queries are not designed for stylistic line-wrapping preferences.

description: Google Style requires every switch statement to be exhaustive, even where the language does not require it. A default label is required even if it contains no code. Enum switches covering all known values are considered exhaustive without a default.

semgrep.limitations: Type resolution needed to determine if switch expression is an enum and if all cases are covered.

pmd.limitations: Requires type resolution to check for enum exhaustiveness.

codeql.limitations: Can detect missing default, but exhaustiveness check for enums requires custom query.

description: Switch rule can be written on single line if it follows Google style (no column overflow; if non-empty block, line break after {). Continuation lines indent +4.

semgrep.limitations: Cannot enforce column overflow or block formatting constraints.

pmd.limitations: Requires custom rule to check line length and block formatting.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query for formatting rules; line length checks are not typical.

description: Detect multiple consecutive blank lines. Permitted but never required or encouraged.

semgrep.limitations: requires custom rule with pattern-either for different line counts

pmd.limitations: PMD does not have a built-in rule for multiple consecutive blank lines; requires custom rule.

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for whitespace analysis

description: After a comma following an enum constant, a line break is optional. Additional blank lines (usually one) are allowed.

semgrep.limitations: Formatting rule not suitable for code pattern detection.

pmd.limitations: Requires custom rule for whitespace/formatting.

codeql.limitations: Formatting rule not suitable for semantic analysis.

description: Number literals must use lowercase letters in hex (0x), octal (0o), and binary (0b) prefixes. Leading zeros are prohibited unless followed by x, o, or b.

semgrep.limitations: requires regex matching on numeric literal tokens

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for literal token text

description: Top-level functions may be defined directly on `exports` object, or declared locally and exported.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

description: Function calls should use the spread operator `...` instead of `Function.prototype.apply`. No space should appear after the `...`.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to detect and suggest replacement

description: Ordinary string literals must be delimited with single quotes `'`, not double quotes `"`. May not span multiple lines. Use template strings to avoid escaping single quotes.

semgrep.limitations: may flag strings containing single quotes that should be template strings

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to distinguish ordinary from required double quotes

description: Array literals must include a trailing comma when there is a line break between the final element and the closing bracket.

semgrep.limitations: requires precise detection of line breaks and array structure

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for formatting rule

description: Interfaces declared with `@interface` or `@record` must have non-static methods with empty bodies and fields declared uninitialized in the constructor.

semgrep.limitations: JSDoc annotation matching may be imprecise

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for JSDoc patterns

description: Use template literals `` `...` `` over complex string concatenation, especially with multiple literals. May span multiple lines.

semgrep.limitations: pattern may match non-string addition; type resolution needed for precision

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

codeql.limitations: requires type information to detect string concatenation

description: Every local variable declaration declares only one variable; no `let a = 1, b = 2;`.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

description: Include a trailing comma after the final property in an object literal when there is a line break between the property and the closing brace.

semgrep.limitations: requires pattern to match the specific missing comma scenario

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for formatting rule

description: Object destructuring patterns allowed. For function parameters, keep to single level of unquoted shorthand properties; no nested or computed. Default to `{}`.

semgrep.limitations: requires custom pattern to enforce 'simple' destructuring constraint

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to check destructuring pattern complexity

description: Avoid adding TODO comments that refer to an individual or team as the context. Use an issue tracker instead.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support Python analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for comment pattern matching

description: Generally only one statement per line. Compound statements like try/except or if/else are not allowed on the same line.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support Python analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to detect multiple statements per line

description: Prefer small and focused functions. Functions exceeding approximately 40 lines should be considered for refactoring.

semgrep.limitations: Semgrep can detect function definitions but requires custom logic to count lines accurately.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support Python analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to compute function body line count.

description: Prefer to specify type parameters for generic types in type annotations; otherwise they are assumed to be `Any`.

semgrep.limitations: requires type resolution to identify generic types and their parameters

codeql.limitations: requires Python type analysis library

description: Prefer `"""` for multi-line strings. Docstrings must use `"""`. Projects may use `'''` for non-docstring multi-line strings if they use `'` for regular strings.

semgrep.limitations: Cannot reliably distinguish docstrings from regular multi-line strings in all contexts without deeper AST analysis.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support Python analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to enforce project-specific conventions for non-docstring strings.

description: Enforce naming conventions for Python identifiers: packages `lower_with_under`, classes `CapWords`, exceptions `CapWords`, functions `lower_with_under()`, constants `CAPS_WITH_UNDER`. Internal versions prefix `_`.

semgrep.limitations: requires custom rules for each identifier type and cannot enforce conventions across entire file/project without multiple patterns

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support Python analysis

codeql.limitations: requires writing custom query for each naming pattern

description: Within each grouping, imports should be sorted lexicographically, ignoring case, according to full package path.

semgrep.limitations: requires custom rule for import ordering analysis

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support Python analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for import ordering

description: Use `str` for string/text data, `bytes` for binary data. Do not use `typing.Text`. Use `typing.AnyStr` if all string types are the same.

description: Avoid using '+' and '+=' to accumulate a string in a loop; use list.append and ''.join to avoid quadratic behavior.

description: Avoid single character names except for counters/iterators (i, j, k, v), e for exception, f for file handle, private type variables, and established mathematical notation.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to exclude allowed cases based on usage context.
